rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday construction for a physical exterior and, with people or resources, something coming from outside.

example.english: The external casing of this machine is cracked.
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 gei1 ngoi6 min6 ge3 hok3 lit6 zo2

rows.note: Use this when the external thing is understood as coming from outside, including outside forces or foreign connections, rather than simply being on the exterior.

example.english: This problem was caused by external factors.
example.traditional: 呢個問題係由外來因素造成嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 hai6 jau4 ngoi6 loi4 jan1 sou3 zou6 sing4 ge3

rows.note: Use this specifically for medicines or substances intended to be applied to the outside of the body.

example.english: This ointment is for external use; you mustn't eat it.
example.traditional: 呢支藥膏係外用嘅，唔可以食㗎。
example.jyutping: ni1 zi1 joek6 gou1 hai6 ngoi6 jung6 ge3 m4 ho2 ji5 sik6 gaa3
